metadata.title: Goldneez | Specialty Coffee Artisenally Roasted
metadata.description: Discover Goldneez, artisanal specialty coffee. We create golden memories for true lovers of authentic flavor.

hero.subtitle: Artisan roasted specialty coffee for lovers of authentic taste
hero.stats: satisfied customers enjoying our coffee every morning

history.title: Our{br}History
history.p1: At Goldneez, we create golden memories through every cup. Our passion for specialty coffee leads us to select the finest single-origin beans, roasting them artisanally to highlight their most distinctive notes.
history.p2: More than a coffee shop, we are a space where aroma, flavor, and company fuse into unforgettable moments.

origin.title: Bean Origin
origin.description: Every bean that arrives at Goldneez is manually selected from sustainable coffee farms in the mountains of Colombia. We work directly with farmers who share our passion for quality, ensuring only the most exceptional beans make it into your next cup of coffee.

items.name: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe
items.description: Floral notes of jasmine and bergamot with a silky body

stages.title: Manual Selection
stages.description: Each bean is visually inspected to discard defective ones

stages.title: Natural Drying
stages.description: Beans are dried in the sun to reduce humidity to 12%

stages.title: Precise Roasting
stages.description: The heart of the process: Maillard, caramel, and development

stages.title: Rapid Cooling
stages.description: Cooling with air to stop the roasting process instantly

stages.title: Rest & Degassing
stages.description: Coffee rests to release CO2 and develop its final profile

experience.title: Sensorial{br}Experience
experience.description: More than just drinking coffee, we invite you to a sensory journey. From the aroma that awakens your senses to the last sip that leaves a smile, every cup at Goldneez is an experience designed to create golden memories.

gallery.title: Our Place
gallery.subtitle: A space designed to create memorable moments

list.text: The best coffee I've ever tasted in my life. The Ethiopia Yirgacheffe has incredible floral notes. Goldneez has become my every morning ritual.
list.name: María Fernández

list.text: More than a coffee shop, it is a sanctuary of coffee. The atmosphere, the aroma, the flavor... everything is designed to create an unforgettable experience.
list.name: Carlos Mendoza

list.text: I take all my clients to Goldneez after meetings. The Signature Blend never disappoints. It is the perfect place to create golden connections.
list.name: Ana Lucía Vargas

list.text: As a certified barista, I can say that Goldneez's roast level is exceptional. Every bean is treated with the respect it deserves.
list.name: Diego Herrera

list.text: I discovered Goldneez a year ago and I haven't bought coffee anywhere else. The quality is consistent and the service is impeccable.
list.name: Laura Jiménez

list.text: My partner and I have our weekly date at Goldneez. The warm atmosphere and perfect coffee make every visit special.
list.name: Roberto Sánchez

ethiopia-yirgacheffe.name: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe
ethiopia-yirgacheffe.description: Floral notes of jasmine and bergamota with a silky body and bright acidity.

colombia-huila.name: Colombia Huila Supremo
colombia-huila.description: Dark chocolate, caramel, and bright citric acidity with a clean finish.

brasil-cerrado.name: Brasil Cerrado Mineiro
brasil-cerrado.description: Roasted nuts, cocoa, and a persistent sweet finish with low acidity.

signature-blend.name: Goldneez Signature Blend
signature-blend.description: Our exclusive house blend: balanced, aromatic, and memorable.

panama-geisha.name: Panama Geisha Reserve
panama-geisha.description: A legendary coffee. Extremely complex profile with floral notes of jasmine and peach.

kenya-aa.name: Kenya AA Kirinyaga
kenya-aa.description: Juicy body, intense berry notes, and a bright phosphoric acidity.

cost-rica.name: Costa Rica Tarrazú Honey
cost-rica.description: Processed with the Honey method. Syrupy sweetness with notes of vanilla and apple.

sumatra-mandheling.name: Sumatra Mandheling
sumatra-mandheling.description: Dense and creamy body. Earthy, spicy notes and dark chocolate.
sumatra-mandheling.notes: Sweet Tobacco, Cedar, Dark Chocolate, Clove
